title: Kneeling Demon Knight
description: A demon knight in red armor with horns and glowing eyes kneels inside a ruined cathedral. His hands hold a hammer and touch an anvil with a glowing red sword blade, while large blue and red fiery wings spread behind him and an open book rests nearby.
prompt: a demon knight in red armor with horns and glowing eyes kneels on the floor of a ruined cathedral with a large stained glass window above. he holds a hammer in one hand and touches an anvil that has a glowing red sword blade on it. large fiery wings in blue and red spread out behind him. an open book with paint marks sits next to the anvil on the stone floor covered in red and blue paint circles and marks. light beams shine down from the broken window above.
